records.description_rewritten: Kamppi's fifth-floor restaurant-area toilet is the part of the shopping centre identified by the original cruising guide, which describes its urinal and cubicle layout. The centre itself confirms that this restroom exists. Earlier 2025 comments mention activity, but the more recent March 2026 message asks whether encounters still happen, so current activity is uncertain.
records.location_identity: Kamppi Helsinki, Urho Kekkosen katu 1, central Helsinki; the fifth-floor Kortteli/restaurant area restrooms.
records.access_conditions: Privately managed shopping mall public toilets. Most centre stores/services typically Mon–Fri 10–20, Sat 10–19, Sun 12–18, but individually operating facilities vary; official website lists 5th-floor free toilets and a paid E-level facility accessible at night. Respect venue rules and other visitors' privacy.

independent_and_secondary_sources.finding: Confirms free toilets on the fifth floor in Kortteli, and nighttime-accessible paid toilets on E level.
